purpose: Document first-party discovery, current viewer configuration, and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The official Ministry of Land viewer is a real public first-party map service and names Barishal Sadar in its current notice. Its page JavaScript was inspected: it uses OpenLayers, a GeoServer WMS/WMTS backend at gis.land.gov.bd, and POST routes /getGeomByCode and /GetPlotInfo for plot geometry/info. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or personal fields were requested. The GIS backend was unavailable during the bounded check, so no geometry was retained.
registryAssessment: Local/public-service evidence is present through the Ministry of Land/DLRS viewer and the official Barishal zonal settlement-office context. This is stronger than general agency prose but does not establish a city-maintained cadastral registry or a complete public cadastral dataset.
